claims.text: Role in HD: a VMAT-2 inhibitor (tetrabenazine, deutetrabenazine) = typical first-line symptomatic tx of chorea;
claims.quote: A vesicular monoamine transporter type 2 (VMAT-2) inhibitor (tetrabenazine, deutetrabenazine) is typically used as a first-line symptomatic treatment of chorea
Doses are sequentially increased as tolerated to control symptoms.

claims.text: avoid w depression (↑worsening depression and suicidality);
claims.quote: VMAT-2 inhibitors should be avoided in patients with depression because the risk of worsening depression and suicidality is increased.

claims.text: other SE: excessive sedation, akathisia, parkinsonism; costly;
claims.quote: Other adverse effects of VMAT-2 inhibitors include excessive sedation, akathisia, and parkinsonism. VMAT-2 inhibitors are also costly.

claims.text: deutetrabenazine appears better tolerated than tetrabenazine.
claims.quote: Deutetrabenazine appears to be better-tolerated than tetrabenazine.
